verdict.rationale: Polar's official remote MCP server issues agent access through OAuth: the user signs in and authorizes the agent for a specific organization, so no raw API key is copied into the agent. That is a first-party, organization-bounded delegated credential for an agent. The evidence never shows selectable permission scopes or least-privilege restrictions. Missing for 10: documented granular token/OAuth scopes, ability to restrict an agent to read-only or specific resources, scoped API key (organization access token) issuance docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
